# <Scope Name> — Decision Log

<!--
A running, append-mostly record of decisions. Newest entries at the top.
Never delete an entry; mark it Superseded and link forward instead.
One entry = one decision, using the format below.
-->

## How to add an entry

Copy this block, fill it in, and add it to the top of the log below.

```markdown
### D-<NNN>: <Short decision title>

- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status:** proposed | accepted | superseded
- **Owner:** <name/role>
- **Context:** <what prompted this decision, in 1-3 sentences>
- **Decision:** <the decision itself, stated plainly>
- **Alternatives considered:** <what else was on the table, and why not>
- **Consequences:** <what this makes easier/harder going forward>
- **Superseded by:** <D-NNN, or "—">
```
